title: Amazon S3 object storage (buckets, durability, security, events)
summary: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) stores objects in buckets with virtually unlimited scale. Learn bucket naming, keys and prefixes, durability and consistency models, storage classes and lifecycle, bucket policies and access control, and event-driven patterns including static website hosting and Lambda triggers.
